terra.problem: The barber joke does not follow: one person letting his hair grow would not put a barber out of work.
“That's got to sting” assigns a reaction to the Nazirite without marking it as Papa Dorin's guess.
The shaving is on the seventh day; consecrating his head again is on the eighth day, not the same day.
“Seven days to cleanse” adds a duration the text does not give. It also does not say he is returning to the Tent of Meeting.
The passage says he rededicates his time of separation; it does not say he makes a new vow.
The health-inspector joke blends the passage's offering basket with a cookie basket, making the offering setting part of the joke.
“That's a nice spread” makes light of the holy portion offered before the LORD.
The passage does not say how long the separation was.
The text says the Nazirite must fulfill his vow, but it does not expressly say no vow can be shortened.
